concept.th-operating-system.def: The program in charge of the machine - it launches your program and manages it while it runs.
concept.th-loader.def: The part of the operating system that copies a program from storage into memory so it can run.
concept.th-entry-point.def: The place where a program starts running - the first instruction the operating system hands to the CPU.
concept.th-main.def: The routine a program starts from, usually named Main.
